caption:
Before you pay any fee, find out whether your profile is actually ready.

That is what the free consultation is for. We look at your residence status, employment, travel history, funds and destination — then tell you plainly whether to apply now or fix something first.

Sometimes the honest answer is wait. Sometimes it is that a different consulate suits you better. Either way you will know before you spend a non-refundable fee.
